title: Custom Trait Contracts
goal: Explicitly implement traits on custom types using impl Trait for Type.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Morning: Implementing Traits

sections.text: You will recognise interfaces from Go, Java, or C++, but Rust does not implement them automatically by matching method names.

sections.caption: A trait defines a contract of required methods.

sections.text: You must write an explicit `impl Trait for Type` block. Without this block, the type does not satisfy the trait even if it has matching methods.

sections.caption: impl Trait for Type connects the capability to the struct.

sections.text: Standard compiler error `E0277` occurs when a generic function expects a trait bound that the type has not implemented.
Associated types and supertraits build on this foundation later in this deck.

explanation: Explicitly implement traits on custom types using impl Trait for Type.
